resource_policy: Inherit original registration and every original attempt, token, unknown usage, elapsed wall time and log byte. No fresh allowance. Original result and evidence remain immutable.
recovery_policy: Reuse exactly fourteen accepted pages. Page 14 must be explicitly revised by the evaluated model. Rejected responses never enter execution. After all eighteen pages an explicit model commit is required. No optimizer or automatic dispatch fallback.
subsequent_interruptions: Persist raw calls, accepted pages, controller progress and physical checkpoints. Do not automatically restart a claimed segment or repeat any completed request. Later-state continuation requires separate verified recovery support.
authorization: User explicitly waived B/C call-count and token-usage restrictions; stage2 development only.
